what: a card or packet of a ranked unit changes (assertion added, sign or depth corrected, abstention lifted, next step named)
detected_by: digest of the unit's cards, assertions, signs, scopes, depths
re_evaluates: positions of the unit (coverage + view regenerate first), then group, class, reasons
reason_class_when_order_moves: new_evidence, counter_evidence or identity_correction (declare with snapshot --reason)

what: a pertinence row is added or changed (assertion judged pertinent to a need, sign, comparator, flags)
detected_by: digest of the unit's rows of coverage/assertion_pertinence.tsv
re_evaluates: the F/C/P position of the card on that need and the specificity flags (G2a/G2b)

what: a new fulltext read receipt on a PMID that a ranked unit cites (a new reading of a source it rests on)
detected_by: count of receipts per cited PMID, read-only from the ledger
re_evaluates: a human re-reads the unit's cards against the new receipt; the digest only raises the flag, it never changes a group by itself

what: a need observation, counter-evidence item, direction or work-order text changes for a need the unit is linked to
detected_by: digest of the linked needs' observation counts, direction and work-order change statements
re_evaluates: context of the unit (F3 needs a WWOX observation on the need; a direction change reverses what is consistent)

what: the pharmacological comparison row of the unit changes (P3 qualification of potency, selectivity, exposure, nervous-system data)
detected_by: digest of the unit's comparison record
re_evaluates: the pharmacology component and, by judgement, the order

what: the catalogue families tied to the unit, their coverage cells or their L2/L3 states change (new catalogue build, identity corrected, name twin resolved)
detected_by: digest of member family ids and the unit's coverage cells
re_evaluates: mechanism component, G4a/G4b split, member table

what: a rule of ranking_it8.py changes meaning (RULES_VERSION)
the daily scout reports a changed source (ChEMBL, DGIdb, openFDA NDC, Open Targets, WWOX PubMed count)
detected_by: existing radar (framework/scripts/scout_daily.py report); no new scheduler
re_evaluates: run repurposing_coverage.py run, then ranking_it8.py run; if the check shows no input digest changed, nothing is re-evaluated and the order is identical
